name: Amritsari Machli (Fish Fry)
ingredients: 500g river fish fillets (singhara or rohu, skinless, cut into 2-inch strips)
1 tsp red chili powder (Kashmiri for color)
1 tbsp dried pomegranate seeds (anardana), coarsely ground
Oil for deep frying (mustard oil preferred)
instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, red chili, ajwain, anardana, garam masala, lemon juice, and salt to form a marinade. 2. Coat fish strips thoroughly with the marinade and refrigerate for 30 minutes. 3. Mix chickpea flour and rice flour in a shallow dish. 4. Dredge each marinated fish piece in the flour mixture, pressing lightly to adhere. 5. Heat oil in a deep pan to 180°C (350°F). 6. Fry fish in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 4-5 minutes per batch. 7. Drain on paper towels and serve immediately with mint chutney and lemon wedges.
description: A golden, crisp symphony of spice-crusted river fish, kissed by turmeric and tangy pomegranate, echoing the bustling lanes of Amritsar.
